title: Example feature for an Express + Postgres app
summary: A verified example card used by the validator tests.

checklist.text: Validate every request body on the server before using it.
Reject request bodies larger than the largest valid payload.
Log failed requests without logging request bodies.

decisions.question: Will third parties call this API?

options.name: Validation middleware
best_fit_when: Most routes share the same rules
tradeoffs: One more layer to read when debugging

notes: Use parameterised queries; never build SQL with string concatenation.

verify.check: A request with an invalid body returns HTTP 400 and changes nothing.
A request body over the size limit returns HTTP 413.
Log lines for failed requests never contain the request body.

body.why: Shared middleware applies the same checks to every route, so a new route cannot skip them by accident. Per-route validation is only worth it when every route is different.

lenses.security: Validate and size-limit every body before any handler runs.

body.mistakes:
- Validating only some routes.
- Accepting unlimited body sizes.
- Logging full request bodies.
